name: Institutional ORB + Brooks Box
tagline: Opening Range Breakout with confluence scoring and Al Brooks price action context
description: A complete opening-range trading system. It builds the opening range, classifies the day type (Coil, Breakout, Trading Range), then grades every breakout with a confluence score from A+ to C using gap analysis, VWAP positioning, relative volume, time-of-day quality, and ADR consumption. Brooks Box logic frames the session in Al Brooks price action context so you only take breakouts with institutional participation behind them.
features: Confluence scoring engine (0–8 points) graded A+ / A / B / C
Automatic day-type classification: COIL, BREAKOUT, TRADING RANGE
Initial Balance extensions with measured-move targets
Gap analysis: up gap, down gap, gap fill tracking
Relative volume gate — signals suppressed without volume confirmation
ADR consumption meter to avoid late-day chasing
Time-of-day quality filter (prime / neutral / caution windows)
Optional suppression of trading-range days and lunch chop

name: Raschke 12 Rules — SireMammat Edition
tagline: Linda Raschke's classic playbook converted into a 12-rule scoring engine
description: Linda Raschke's trading principles encoded into an objective bull/bear scoring engine. Each of the 12 rules is checked in real time — EMA stack alignment, momentum, volume, range expansion and more — and produces a live Bull Score and Bear Score from 0–12. When a side reaches the minimum threshold with volume confirmation, the indicator prints a graded signal: from full trend entries to pullback continuations, failed-breakout fades, and exhaustion warnings.
features: Live Bull Score and Bear Score (0–12) with rule-by-rule checklist
Triple EMA stack analysis (9 / 20 / 50) with alignment states
Signal quality grading: STRONG, SOLID, MODERATE, WEAK
Six signal types covering trend, pullback, fade, and exhaustion setups
Volume confirmation gate on every signal
RSI and ATR context in the dashboard panel

name: Sire Trade Qualification
tagline: Eight-point pre-trade gate — only fires when institutional context lines up
description: A pre-trade qualification engine, not a signal generator. Every bar is run through eight institutional checks — EMA 20/50/200 trend stack, volume against its MA, proximity to prior swing levels, session timing, strong-bar confirmation, ATR-bounded stop distance, minimum R:R, and higher-timeframe context. A setup only qualifies when at least 6 of 8 pass. The live scorecard shows you exactly which checks failed in real time, so you can read context — not just signals. Designed to be paired with the Brooks Box framework on the same chart for the highest-conviction entries.
features: Eight institutional checks scored 0–8 with live pass/fail scorecard
≥6/8 gate threshold — only qualified setups print FIRE labels
Long and Short scores tracked independently in real time

Configurable bar numbering for RTH and ETH session structure

name: Sire Cockpit
tagline: All-in-one price-action HUD — structure, timing, bias and ICT zones on a single chart
description: A full chart command center that layers seven modules into one overlay so you can read structure, timing, bias and institutional zones at a glance. Market structure is mapped with automatic HH / HL / LH / LL pivots and self-extending support/resistance. A TD Sequential engine counts setups and prints 9s and 13s. A fast/slow EMA pair plus a higher-timeframe 200 EMA give trend bias. Inside-bar and IOI (inside-outside-inside) compression patterns are flagged, and a session bar-counter keeps you oriented inside the RTH window. The ICT layer draws Fair Value Gaps, Implied FVGs, Liquidity Voids, Volume Imbalances and true Gaps with full mitigation tracking. Standard FVG zones are detected on a selectable higher timeframe (30-minute by default) using only closed candles, so the zones are non-repainting and drawn cleanly on your execution chart. ICT zone engine adapted from open-source work by Vulnerable_human_x under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.
features: Auto market structure: HH / HL / LH / LL pivots with self-extending support & resistance
TD Sequential setup counter with 9 and 13 prints plus optional pulse trails
EMA stack (fast/slow) plus higher-timeframe 200 EMA with slope coloring
Multi-timeframe FVG detection — pick any timeframe, 30m default, non-repainting
Full ICT zone engine: FVG, Implied FVG, Liquidity Void, Volume Imbalance, true Gaps
Mitigation tracking with Engulf / Mitigate / Rebalance modes and live highlight on tag
Inside-bar coloring (on by default) and IOI compression pattern flags
Session bar-counter for RTH structure with configurable interval and hourly markers
On-chart SireMammat's Cockpit watermark with full position and styling control

name: GreenLight Pro Enhanced
tagline: Eight subsystems on one clean chart — L8/B8 momentum gated by EMA, volume, structure and a 0–4 confluence score
description: A streamlined multi-system trading suite that folds momentum signal generation, structural swing analysis, TD Sequential exhaustion, candlestick patterns and volume analysis into one clean overlay. The heart is the GreenLight Core: it counts consecutive momentum bars (L1–L8 / B1–B8) and only fires an L8/B8 PRO signal when six filters agree — EMA side, EMA slope, 0.75× ATR proximity, 1.2× volume, trending structure, and a configurable 0–4 confluence score. Around it sit Brooks' Gap 20 tracker, the 18-bar RTH opening-range box (Coil / BO / TR), TD Sequential, OO/II/IOI candle patterns, two-leg & 3-push wedge detection, and HH/HL/LH/LL swing structure with dynamic S/R. This Clean Edition strips the old PA-entry arrows, Always-In arrows, inside-bar breakout arrows and the duplicate slow EMA, leaving only high-conviction, actionable signals. Optimized for MNQ/MES futures; works on any instrument with volume.

Signal quality scoring printed on every label (EMA agreement, volume, structure, Gap 20 context)

Momentum dashboard, ATR/ABR table, RTH+ETH bar counter, session stats, and 11 alert conditions

howToUse: Open TradingView and go to Pine Editor (bottom panel).
Copy the full source from the file linked below and paste it into the editor.
Click "Add to chart". Use a 5-minute chart (primary) on MNQ/MES/NQ/ES; add a 15-minute for confirmation.
Let the opening range form, then read the State Table — if it shows CHOP (orange), stand aside; if TREND (green), proceed.
Take L8/B8 PRO labels scoring 3/4 or 4/4 in the direction of the structure; treat L4/B4 dots as a heads-up only.
Confirm with the dashboard (structure matches direction), TD Sequential (no opposing exhaustion) and swing structure, then use the R:R overlay's stop and target to manage the trade.
bestPractices: Trend only — L8/B8 fire just in UPTREND/DOWNTREND; in TRADING RANGE or CHOP the signals are suppressed, so don't force them.
Best window is the 10:00–11:30 ET morning session on above-average volume; the 11:30–13:30 lunch lull produces lower-probability signals.
Prioritize score 4/4 over 3/4, and weight setups where multiple systems agree (e.g. L8 PRO + UPTREND + HH/HL, or B8 PRO + TD Buy CD13 + Gap 20).
Respect the 18-bar box: COIL favors a patient breakout, BO favors trading with trend, TR favors fading the extremes.
A Countdown 13 or a 3-push wedge against your direction is a reason to tighten or wait — confirm exhaustion before countering a trend.

name: TD Sequential
tagline: Tom DeMark momentum-exhaustion system — Setup 9 and Countdown 13 for reversal detection
description: A momentum-exhaustion indicator developed by Tom DeMark in the 1990s, used by institutional desks worldwide. It works in two phases: Setup (1–9) counts consecutive directional bars relative to the close four bars earlier, and Countdown (1–13) confirms exhaustion. A completed Setup 9 is a caution flag; a Countdown 13 is the highest-conviction reversal signal in the system. Best used to call exhaustion at the end of an extended trend, never as a standalone.

Countdown phase (1–13) confirms the reversal zone
Recycling detection when a new setup interrupts the countdown
Most reliable on 15-minute and higher timeframes
Institutional-grade methodology used across major platforms

name: Sire FVG Setup Finder
tagline: ICT Fair Value Gaps with a full trade plan — auto entry, stop and target the moment price taps the imbalance
description: Most FVG indicators stop at drawing boxes. This one finishes the job. It detects every 3-candle imbalance (Fair Value Gap), filters out the noise with an ATR size gate, then waits for the moment that actually matters — price trading back into the gap. That tap is the setup. The instant it happens, the indicator prints a complete trade plan on your chart: entry at the gap edge, stop beyond the far edge with an ATR cushion, and a target set by your risk:reward. It then tracks the trade live and marks whether TP or SL got hit first — with a conservative SL-first rule on ambiguous bars, so it never flatters its own results. Written in Pine v6.
features: Bullish and bearish FVG detection (3-candle imbalance) with ATR minimum-size filter
Setup flag the moment price mitigates the gap — wick taps AND full pierces both count
Auto trade plan on every setup: Entry / SL / TP lines with price labels
Two entry modes (gap edge or touch-bar close) and two stop modes (gap far edge + buffer, or pure ATR)
Honest exit tracking — no same-bar instant exits, SL-first default when one bar hits both levels
Six alert conditions: gap formed (bull/bear), long entry, short entry, TP hit, SL hit

signals.name: Long Setup ▲
signals.meaning: Price taps back into a bullish FVG (gap below price) — green triangle below the bar, Entry/SL/TP plotted

signals.name: Short Setup ▼
signals.meaning: Price taps back into a bearish FVG (gap above price) — red triangle above the bar, Entry/SL/TP plotted

signals.name: Setup done from FVG
signals.meaning: The mitigation label — the gap has been tapped and is now spent; first touch is the trade

signals.name: TP hit / SL hit
signals.meaning: Label printed at the level when the open trade plan resolves

settings.name: Min gap size
settings.description: Filter gaps by ATR multiple — 0.25 kills most noise on NQ/MNQ

settings.name: Entry price
settings.description: Enter at the near edge of the gap, or at the touch-bar close

settings.name: Stop-Loss
settings.description: Stop beyond the opposite edge + ATR buffer, or fixed ATR distance

settings.name: SL buffer
settings.description: Cushion past the stop level so a 1-tick sweep doesn't take you out

settings.name: Risk : Reward
settings.description: TP distance as a multiple of risk — 2R default

settings.name: One trade at a time
settings.description: Ignores new setups while a plan is still live

settings.name: Same-bar TP+SL
settings.description: Conservative call when one bar covers both levels

howToUse: Open TradingView and go to Pine Editor (bottom panel).
Copy the full source from the file linked below and paste it into the editor.
Click "Add to chart". Works 1m–4H; 5m–15m is the sweet spot for ES/NQ session trading.
Set Min gap size to 0.25–0.5× ATR — untouched, it will draw every micro-gap.
Wait for the Setup flag — the gap forming is context, the tap is the trade.
Set alerts to "Once per bar close" if you want confirmed signals only; intrabar taps fire live.
bestPractices: Trade with displacement — the best FVGs form on a strong impulse leg. A gap inside chop is a skip.
Direction filter — take longs only into bullish FVGs above HTF support, shorts into bearish FVGs below HTF resistance. Don't fade the daily.
Fresh gaps only — first tap is the trade. A gap that's been tapped is spent; the indicator enforces this for you.
No News — skip if FOMC, CPI, or NFP is within 30 minutes. Imbalances get run both ways.
It's a map, not a backtest — this is an indicator, not a strategy(). The TP/SL tracking is honest (SL-first, no same-bar exits) but it is not fill simulation. Size accordingly.
